transcriptText:
This call wins you 10 chips a time... on average. Make it ten times. How often are you still behind? Guess first... anywhere from 0 to 100%.

Meet two players. Blue makes a good call, worth +10. Coral makes a bad one, worth −10. Both win 30% of the time. After ten calls, Blue's behind 38% of the time. Coral's ahead 35%. Sit a thousand players in Coral's seat for ten calls... and about 350 are winning.

Now turn the dial. After a hundred calls, Blue's behind just 11%. Coral's still ahead 22%. After a thousand... Blue's almost never behind. Coral's ahead about 1%. The luck washes out, and the decision shows.

So what should Blue expect after a hundred calls? +10, a hundred times... +1,000. But a typical swing is about 917, either way. So an ordinary run lands anywhere from about +83 to +1,917.

So ten good results don't prove a good player. A few hands show luck. Thousands show the decision.
